channel.title: Dekho Hatke
channel.description: Practical coding tutorials and fixes for Python, Android, C++, JavaScript and bots.

item.title: Fix Telegram Bot Error 409: Conflict Terminated by Other getUpdates Request
item.description: Telegram bot crashing with 409 Conflict? Find the second running copy, clear a stuck webhook and make sure only one instance ever polls.

item.title: Render Says No Open Ports Detected? Fix Your Flask and Gunicorn Start
item.description: Deploy fails with Port scan timeout on Render? Bind to 0.0.0.0 and the PORT variable, fix the gunicorn command and run a bot with a health server.

item.title: Fix the CORS Error When Your Static Website Calls a Flask API
item.description: Blocked by CORS policy in the browser console? Learn what preflight is and fix it in Flask, including credentials, redirects and error responses.

item.title: Fix BeautifulSoup AttributeError: NoneType Object Has No Attribute get_text
item.description: Why find and select_one return None, how to debug the real HTML your script receives and how to write scraping code that survives missing elements.

item.title: BeautifulSoup Returns Empty Results? Find the Hidden JSON API Instead
item.description: When a page loads data with JavaScript, the HTML you download is empty. Use DevTools to find the JSON request behind the page and call it in Python.

item.title: Android RecyclerView Blank? Fix No Adapter Attached; Skipping Layout
item.description: A seven point checklist for an empty RecyclerView in Java: adapter, LayoutManager, item count, row layout height, data refresh and ListAdapter traps.

item.title: Find a C++ Segmentation Fault with AddressSanitizer and gdb
item.description: Stop guessing why your program prints Segmentation fault. Reproduce it, read an AddressSanitizer report, get a gdb backtrace and fix the usual causes.

item.title: Cron Job Not Running Your Python Script? Seven Causes and Fixes
item.description: Your script works in the terminal but silently does nothing from cron. Fix PATH, working directory, percent signs, time zones and missing logs.

item.title: Python CSV Shows Garbage Characters in Excel? Use utf-8-sig
item.description: Hindi text, the rupee sign or accented letters turn into odd symbols when a Python CSV opens in Excel. Understand why and fix it with one argument.

item.title: Python requests Hangs or Fails Randomly? Timeouts, Retries and Sessions
item.description: A script that freezes or breaks on one bad response needs a timeout, a retry policy and a Session. Copy a hardened requests helper for any project.

item.title: Python Web Scraping with BeautifulSoup
item.description: Learn web scraping with Python, requests and BeautifulSoup: download pages politely, parse HTML, follow pagination and save clean CSV data.

item.title: Android Java: RecyclerView Step by Step
item.description: Build an Android RecyclerView in Java step by step: adapter, ViewHolder, click handling, adding and removing items, and DiffUtil.

item.title: JavaScript Fetch API: A Practical Guide
item.description: Learn JavaScript fetch: GET and POST, error handling, timeouts with AbortController, retries and calling your own backend from a static site.

item.title: C++ Pointers Explained Simply
item.description: Understand C++ pointers with simple examples: addresses, dereferencing, nullptr, const, new and delete, and smart pointers.

item.title: Build a Telegram Bot That Reports to You
item.description: Send alerts, files and error tracebacks from Python to your phone with a Telegram bot. Includes a reusable notifier module and security tips.

item.title: Schedule Python Scripts with Cron and Render
item.description: Schedule Python scripts with cron, a free Render web service or GitHub Actions, with working code, honest limits and security tips.

item.title: Automate Your Daily Tasks with Python
item.description: Automate daily tasks with Python: organise folders, delete old files, rename photos and send reports, using safe dry-run scripts.
